general_advice: Start with the forts; they open up the sea map and give a trophy.
Sail to all islands to unlock fast travel.
Do the 7 underwater shipwrecks once story progress allows diving.
Do the cleanup, then finish the legendary ships.
Sync viewpoints on each island to reveal collectibles on the map.
Use the map filter (D-Pad Down) to show one collectible type at a time.
Each of the 46 named locations has its own tracker.

Nothing is missable. Story gates: shipwrecks after Sequence 06 Mission 01; northern Tulum after Sequence 04 Mission 03; Isla Providencia during or after Sequence 08 Mission 03; Principe during or after Sequence 09 Mission 02; Long Bay during or after Sequence 10 Mission 03; portraits need story progress.
Free roam continues after the story, so skipped things can be done later.
gaps: Rewards for most non-trophy types are not stated.
notes: The intro and the type list give different counts for paintings, swords and pistols; the lower intro numbers are the trophy requirements.
